stories.title: Big tech spends more than $1 trillion on AI infrastructure — additional $745 billion expected to be added to the figure in 2026 alone

sources.title: Big tech spends more than $1 trillion on AI infrastructure — additional $745 billion expected to be added to the figure in 2026 alone
sources.title_en: Big tech spends more than $1 trillion on AI infrastructure — additional $745 billion expected to be added to the figure in 2026 alone
sources.title_original: Big tech spends more than $1 trillion on AI infrastructure — additional $745 billion expected to be added to the figure in 2026 alone
sources.summary: Amazon, Google, Meta, and Microsoft have collectively spent more than $1 trillion on AI investments since the rush started in 2023. However, the big four are planning to spend more on AI CAPEX, with billions more planned for this year, even as their "hidden debt" balloons to over $1.65 trillion.
sources.summary_zh: 自 2023 年人工智能投资热潮开始以来，亚马逊、谷歌、Meta 和微软在人工智能投资上总共花费了超过 1 万亿美元。然而，四大巨头计划在人工智能资本支出上投入更多资金，今年计划再增加数十亿美元，尽管它们的“隐性债务”已飙升至超过 1.65 万亿美元。

stories.title: Microsoft vows to make Windows 11 fly on 8GB RAM amid memory shortage — optimizations to reduce OS memory footprint have begun

sources.title: Microsoft vows to make Windows 11 fly on 8GB RAM amid memory shortage — optimizations to reduce OS memory footprint have begun
sources.title_en: Microsoft vows to make Windows 11 fly on 8GB RAM amid memory shortage — optimizations to reduce OS memory footprint have begun
sources.title_original: Microsoft vows to make Windows 11 fly on 8GB RAM amid memory shortage — optimizations to reduce OS memory footprint have begun
sources.summary: While the company's minimum OS specifications officially say 4GB, most PC builders know that 16GB is the bare minimum for a smooth experience on Windows 11. However, the memory chip shortage and the resurgence of 8GB laptops are likely forcing Microsoft to optimize Windows.
sources.summary_zh: 虽然该公司的最低操作系统规格官方称 4GB，但大多数 PC 制造商都知道 16GB 是 Windows 11 流畅体验的最低要求。然而，内存芯片短缺和 8GB 笔记本电脑的复苏可能迫使微软优化 Windows。
